verdicts.decision_note: The client explicitly requires a polished, premium report design suitable for a professional paid assessment.
First target-specific implementation claim: the freelancer reports completion of the initial report design concept.
The client retains the accepted design direction while establishing final priorities for readability, consistency, polish, and commercial finish.
Target-specific post-modification claim: the freelancer reports updating the design according to the immediately preceding refinement instructions.
The generic statement that all changes look good does not uniquely verify this Requirement among the multiple design and deliverable Requirements under review.
